sources.title: GitHub - jaredpalmer/kev: Jev-like family of decision models built on ...
sources.snippet: What to Expect says where Kev is as good as Jev and where it isn't. Kev-0.8B, 4B and 9B start from Qwen base models and share one training recipe. Kev-27B starts from Qwen's post-trained release, and we don't know what that was trained on. Each model card has the full recipe, all results, and the earlier versions kept as Hub tags.

sources.title: Releases · jaredpalmer/kev - GitHub
sources.snippet: The current Kev family: Kev-27B, Kev-9B, Kev-4B, Kev-0.8B. Open decision models: typed questions in, calibrated probabilities out, one forward pass, no text generation. Each is a LoRA adapter (r=16) plus a pointer head on a frozen Qwen base, which downloads on first load. This release holds only the current best version of each size; every earlier version stays on the Hub (below).
